prompts.basic:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fighting game whole-body raster sprites on a truly transparent background. A perfectly spaced 4 column x 4 row grid, exactly 16 isolated complete whole-body poses, no labels, no text, no cell lines, no ground shadows, NO attack effects, NO glow or dust. Every pose fits fully INSIDE its own cell with at least 25 pixels clear on ALL sides. No head, weapon, scarf, hair, foot may cross a cell boundary. Keep the same adult/child proportions, head size, limb lengths, face, clothes, equipment and polished detailed anime cel shading throughout. Baseline body height per figure about 170-185 pixels in a 1536x1024 sheet. All active poses look and move toward image RIGHT, three-quarter side view; turn is the only opposite angle. Row-major order: 0 neutral ready stance facing an opponent on the right (NOT a front-facing character sheet pose); 1 left foot forward walking; 2 walking passing; 3 right foot forward walking; 4 walking passing opposite; 5 run long stride; 6 run tucked passing; 7 opposite run stride; 8 opposite tucked passing; 9 dash launch low; 10 braking step; 11 crouch; 12 turning; 13 jump squat; 14 jump ascent; 15 second jump. Important: cell0 proportions are the fixed identity baseline for all future sprites. Reference is for design and pose intent, do not copy its labels/effects or other characters.
Character: Viewtiful Joe exactly as the attached design. Compact athletic red masked superhero, round red helmet with two long silver horn antennae, black visor with bright yellow angular eye lenses and V crest, bright golden yellow long scarf, red bodysuit, white gloves and white boots. Preserve his compact ~3.5-head superhero anatomy rather than a tall adult. Only Joe; no motorcycle or civilians in this movement sheet.
prompts.selectionFirst:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a DEDICATED ultra detailed high resolution character-selection portrait. Single character only, truly transparent background. Close head and shoulders crop: entire top of head/accessories visible with a comfortable 6 percent transparent top margin; face centered horizontally, eyes at upper third; shoulders extend to bottom and fill the width. Face, collar and shoulder upper body ONLY, not full body or distant waist-up. Crisp professional anime game illustration matching the supplied character design. Precise eyes, high detail linework and cel shaded highlights. Three-quarter view towards the RIGHT, confident fighting expression. No text, logos, frame, UI, symbols or background. This is a separately illustrated high resolution portrait, never an enlarged sprite.
Viewtiful Joe: round glossy red helmet, two tall silver antennae/horns entirely in frame, yellow V crest and angular eye lenses in black visor, small visible determined mouth, red muscular shoulders and prominent golden yellow scarf. Face is the visor and mouth area; center that area, not the horns.
